brief.headline: Revenue moved -2.9% while operating income fell 38%, with interest income supplying 32% of pre-tax income and a regulatory-credit line at 2.8% of revenue carrying 26.9% of the top-line change.

threads.title: Earnings composition
threads.reading: Revenue moved -2.9%, from $97.69B to $94.83B, while operating income fell 38%, from $7.08B to $4.36B, which the financial condition check reads as a change in cost structure or pricing rather than volume (Class A, 10-K filed 2026-01-29). Of $5.28B pre-tax income, $1.68B — 32% — is interest income, which moves with rates and cash balances rather than with demand for the product. The same shape appears in the most recent testable quarter: the company's release states revenue up 26% YoY to $28.2B and operating income down 57% to $0.4B at a 1.4% margin, and the claims check matched both to figures reported to the SEC for 2026-06-30.
supporting: Revenue held close to flat, moving -2.9% from $97.69B to $94.83B (Financial condition check, Class A, 10-K filed 2026-01-29).

The release's stated quarterly revenue of $28.20B was matched against $28.24B reported to the SEC for 2026-06-30, a 0.13% difference (Management claims check, Class B release against Class A figures).

The release's stated quarterly operating income of $400.00M was matched against $398.00M reported to the SEC, a 0.50% difference — what was said publicly and what was filed agree (Management claims check).
against: Operating income fell 38% against a -2.9% revenue move (Financial condition check, high severity, Class A).
Interest income of $1.68B is 32% of $5.28B pre-tax income — a large share of pre-tax income comes from the balance sheet rather than operations (Financial condition check, Class A).

The release the claims check verified states operating income down 57% YoY at a 1.4% operating margin for the quarter ended 2026-06-30, a steeper version of the annual pattern (Class B release, figures matched to Class A).

threads.title: Revenue composition
threads.reading: Automotive regulatory credits are 2.8% of revenue but carried 26.9% of the total revenue change, falling $770.00M from $2.76B to $1.99B — 9.5x the line's weight (Revenue composition, Class A). Two lines moved the other way: energy generation and storage sales grew $2.71B, masking 95% of the period's decline, and services and other grew $2.00B, masking 70%. The reported top line still fell 2.9%, so the growth sits in lines outside vehicle sales while the credit line shrank.
supporting: Energy generation and storage sales grew $2.71B, masking 95% of the decline (Revenue composition check, Class A, disaggregation of revenue schedule).
Services and other grew $2.00B, masking 70% of the decline (same check, Class A).
Both growing lines are reported in the same disaggregation schedule as the shrinking one, read from the 10-K filed 2026-01-29 (Class A).
against: Automotive regulatory credits fell $770.00M, from $2.76B to $1.99B, carrying 26.9% of the total movement while making up 2.8% of the prior-period base — 9.5x its weight, flagged high severity (Revenue composition, Class A).
Even with both growing lines, revenue still moved -2.9% for the year (Financial condition check, Class A).

Operating income fell 38% over the same period in which energy generation and storage grew $2.71B and services and other grew $2.00B (Financial condition and Revenue composition checks, both Class A).

threads.title: Risk language against the safety record
threads.reading: Across 38 risk factors the filing added 2, removed 3, modified 30 and left 6 unchanged. The removed demand factor framed growth around consumers' demand for electric vehicles in an industry described as generally competitive and cyclical; the added one frames growth around demand for electric vehicles and adoption of autonomous driving solutions, and a second addition covers Bots, including Optimus, in what the filing calls a nascent industry that has yet to develop commercially. Over the same window the safety check recorded six NHTSA campaigns between 2025-03-18 and 2026-07-07, four of them on Cybertruck, out of 16 on record.
supporting: The risk section was actively revised rather than carried forward: 30 of 38 factors modified, only 6 unchanged (Filing language check, Class A).
The added factors disclose new subject matter — autonomous driving adoption and Bots including Optimus — in the current 10-K (Filing language check, Class A, 10-K filed 2026-01-29).

The NHTSA descriptions are narrowly scoped: vehicles originally built for a foreign market, a missing certification label, a service-installed accessory light bar, and parking-light brightness above a maximum (Safety record check, Class A).
against: Six recall campaigns fall between 2025-03-18 and 2026-07-07, four on Cybertruck, including brake rotor stud holes that may crack and allow the stud to separate from the wheel hub, campaign 26V255000 reported 2026-04-22 (Safety record, Class A, NHTSA).
A Federal Register notice dated 2026-07-17 records denial of a Tesla petition for decision of inconsequential noncompliance (Federal Register, listed Class A in the corroborating feed).

Three factors were removed in the same revision — the prior demand factor, obligations under the agreement with the Research Foundation for the State University of New York relating to Gigafactory New York, and one on scrutiny and changing expectations regarding ESG practices (Filing language check, high severity, Class A).

Class F headlines dated 2026-08-21 and 2026-08-22 describe a recall of nearly 3 million vehicles in China over door handles; nothing in the Class A material covers it, and the safety check is scoped to NHTSA (Hacker News mentions, Class F — corroboration only).

threads.title: The comparison base
threads.reading: Two closed-period net income figures for 2024 were revised after the fact. The period ending 2024-06-30 was lowered from $1,478,000,000 as first filed on 2024-07-24 to $1,400,000,000 in a filing dated 2025-07-24, a change of -5.3%. The period ending 2024-03-31 was raised from $1,129,000,000 to $1,390,000,000, +23.1%, in a filing dated 2025-04-23. Both land inside the prior-year base that this year's comparisons run against.
supporting: 351 reported figures are on file with 0 new to the ledger — the set of concepts being reported did not change (Restatements check, Class A, SEC XBRL company facts).
The two revisions run in opposite directions, one down 5.3% and one up 23.1% (Restatements check, Class A).
Both management statements that could be tested matched the figures filed with the SEC, within 0.13% and 0.50% (Management claims check, Class B release against Class A figures).
against: Net income for the period ending 2024-06-30 was lowered from $1,478,000,000 to $1,400,000,000 a year after the original filing (Restatements check, high severity, Class A).
Net income for the period ending 2024-03-31 was raised from $1,129,000,000 to $1,390,000,000, a 23.1% change to a closed period (Restatements check, high severity, Class A).
The check's own note records that closed-period revisions are rarely announced and change every comparison drawn against them (Restatements check, Class A).

brief.corroboration: The Class B earnings release is the only non-primary source that could be matched to filed figures, and both matched, within 0.13% and 0.50%. The Class F material — press surfaced through Hacker News plus one community post, the weakest item on the page — points at a China recall of nearly 3 million vehicles over door handles and at the discontinuation of the Solar Roof; neither has a Class A counterpart here, and Class F can flag the subject but settles nothing. The Federal Register notices listed alongside it are labelled Class A and include the 2026-07-17 denied petition and several foreign-trade-zone authorizations for battery storage production.
not_checked: 8 of 10 management claims were not testable against a filed figure; only quarterly revenue and operating income for 2026-06-30 could be matched (Management claims check).
NHTSA coverage is scoped to make 'tesla', model years 2024-2026, so campaigns outside that make and year range are not reflected beyond the count of 16 on record.
Per-share figures are excluded from the restatement check, so any revision expressed only per share would not surface.
The Class F reports of a China recall and of the Solar Roof being discontinued have no Class A counterpart in this material and could not be checked against any filing.
Revenue composition was read from the annual disaggregation schedule only; no interim period composition was checked.
The SEC filing feed lists a 10-Q filed 2026-07-23 and several Form 4, Form 144 and Schedule 13G/A filings, but their contents were not part of any check.
Three risk factor excerpts are truncated mid-sentence in the material, so the full text of the removed demand factor and of the rewritten Musk share-pledge factor could not be read.
